item.title: This Week in Louisiana Politics: Senate qualifying, combating child exploitation, and Kennedy condemns Krewe of Carrollton
item.description: Sen. Bill Cassidy and Rep. Julia Letlow have officially qualified for Louisiana's U.S. Senate race, setting up a competitive Republican primary battle, while Attorney General Liz Murrill has announced a new partnership to combat child exploitation, and the U.S. 5th Circuit Court of Appeals has ruled against several drug companies regarding a Louisiana law limiting drug prices.

item.title: Four-wheelers, dirt bikes confiscated for alleged reckless driving in New Orleans

item.title: Arrest made in January shooting near Baton Rouge auto parts store
item.description: Shun Beardon, 23, was arrested and charged with attempted first-degree murder and armed robbery after allegedly shooting a man in the leg during an armed robbery at an Advance Auto Parts store on Scenic Highway in January.
